statements.impact_statement: The runtime image is gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot (digest sha256:afa5c872c891853ca7fcf1f12c3edb23f7eeef36189728842dd51042ff57f7ab, still the current tag as of 2026-11-21), which ships ca-certificates 20250419~deb12u1. DLA-4845-1 removes trust in compromised eMudhra / emSign intermediates. This process is a Go 1.27.4 binary; Go 1.27.3 and later reject those chains in crypto/x509 (GO-2026-6809) even if the system store still contains the roots. The image digest will be refreshed when distroless publishes a base that includes 20250419~deb12u2.
DLA-4792-1 ships a newer timezone database (2026c), not a vulnerability in tzdata. It does not affect payment, TLS, or access control.
DLA-4854-1 ships a newer timezone database (2026e), not a vulnerability in tzdata. It does not affect payment, TLS, or access control.
DLA-4867-1 ships a newer timezone database (2026f), not a vulnerability in tzdata. It does not affect payment, TLS, or access control.
